_readme: Copy this file to smtp-config.json and fill in the password. smtp-config.json is gitignored so your credentials never get committed. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_gmail_note: For Gmail you must enable 2-Step Verification, then generate a 16-character App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Your normal account password will NOT work. Paste the app password below with or without spaces.
